primary: Within the same Korean subject, external observers reject negative-emotion (angry/sad) self-reports at higher rate than positive/neutral self-reports (OR_angry_vs_neutral > 1.5).
null_hypothesis: No emotion asymmetry; OR=1, within-subject Δ(neg−pos)=0
failure_implication: If asymmetry is small/absent, self-observer congruence framing collapses; would have to revert to a label-noise framing.

primary: Adding Human-KL distillation (λ=0.1) over a strong stage6_full baseline, both trained on master_v_yonsei.csv, improves val_f1_macro by at least 0.3pp (paired_delta CI lower > 0.003) across 3 seeds (42, 123, 777).
null_hypothesis: No improvement; paired delta within ±0.3pp band.
failure_implication: Even with corrected labels and 10-100× larger λ than prior phase-6 attempts, Human-KL distillation gives no model-level benefit — narrative needs a different model integration (multi-task head, calibration, etc.) to bridge statistics → model improvement.

primary: For an appearance-based model trained on self-report labels, accuracy on samples the external rater REJECTED (yon_reject_rate=1, group B) is far below accuracy on AGREED samples (yon_reject_rate=0, group A): acc(A) - acc(B) >= 0.30 and acc(A) >= 0.95. This would mean val F1 ~0.926 reflects a single-external-rater agreement ceiling, not model capacity.
null_hypothesis: No meaningful gap between acc(A) and acc(B); model performance is independent of external-rater agreement (acc(A)-acc(B) < 0.15), implying headroom remains on rejected samples.
failure_implication: If acc(B) is high (gap < 0.15), the model is NOT annotation-ceiling-limited. Real headroom exists on rejected samples; the congruence signal is exploitable via a better integration than KL distillation (multi-task head / sample reweighting). Reopens the model-improvement angle that exp_002 closed for KL.

primary: acc(A_agree)-acc(B_reject) >= 0.30 and acc(A) >= 0.95 (hard agreement ceiling). REJECTED: gap=16.95pp, acc(A)=0.943. PARTIAL ceiling — disagreement is the largest single error source but model retains 77.3pct on rejected (>>chance), i.e. predicts self-report better than a single external rater. Residual headroom ~1.5-2pp lives in genuinely ambiguous samples that exp_002 KL distill failed to exploit. Full numbers in exp_003/results.json + leaderboard notes.
null_hypothesis: No meaningful A vs B gap (acc(A)-acc(B) < 0.15).

primary: On observer-reject samples, model recovers self-report in a substantial fraction: V3/(V3+V4)=P(pred=self|reject) >= 0.50 (3 baseline seeds). Operationalizes observer rejection != self-report invalidity.
null_hypothesis: V3/(V3+V4) < 0.50 — V4 dominates, rejection marks invisible self-report.
